answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 32727 Country: India Title: eating of non halal meat unknowingly Question: I work in a banking co. My co had arrangd lunch in a restuarant. I too partcpated in it, but afterwards i though of the meat served there was non halal.Kindly advise what should i do since eating non halal meat is forbidden in Islam. Answer ID: 32727 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 986/L=395/TL=1432) Now you should do tauba and istighfar. It is the kaffarah. Avoid participating in such parties in future. If you have to participate sometimes, you should use only halal and undoubted items. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
